title: SmileDirectClub: Closing the Gap with Affordability - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 22]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be breaking down SmileDirectClub, the oral care company known for its affordable clear aligner treatment.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be breaking down SmileDirectClub, the oral care company known for its affordable clear aligner treatment. SmileDirectClub was founded in 2014 as a direct-to-consumer alternative to metal braces. It has since expanded to serve over 1 million customers in both the US and abroad.

key_points.text: To help break down the business, host Jesse Pujji is joined by current CFO Kyle Wailes.
In this breakdown, we discuss how SmileDirectClub differentiates itself relative to metal braces and clear aligner competitors like Invisalign.
We touch on the company’s DTC roots, how they have expanded TAM in the oral care market.
